name: Gaia DR4 Lightcurves
description: Gaia Data Release 4 is the fourth data release of the European Space Agency (ESA) Gaia mission. It is released on 2 December 2026, 12:00 CET. This page is for the lightcurves (epoch photometry). LINCC Frameworks will convert Gaia DR4 to HATS in three stages: sources, then lightcurves, then spectra.
